semantic.justification: Task AQF9AG replaces projected input-date/year fields with the actual language-owned ImpSvNumberInputScan instance. Its source defaults, twenty fragment slots, parse-state reset, cached-separator locale invalidation, raw null-date assignment and two-digit-year accessors are represented. Source ASCII-digit/non-digit division, near-capacity complete-thousands-group collapse, substring skips, native blank characters, date-word boundaries, locale decimal and grouping separators, leading/exponent signs and numeric-fragment step are represented. IsNumberFormat and its classification/conversion stages remain unported; no heuristic substitute is claimed. Task AQF9AG ports source AM/PM matching and fractional-second separator recognition, including ISO dot/comma acceptance and locale fallback. Task AQF9AG ports source time-part conversion, AM/PM adjustment, duration/lax bounds, leap second and fractional seconds; output is written even for rejected times. Task AQF9AG ports whole-input logical-word comparison against the native format-scanner keywords. Task AQF9AG adds source cached ISO and named-month date shapes, bounded day/year fragment conversion and MatchedReturn; complete date classification remains unported. Task AQF9AG adds source compiled-format literal/currency token selection, negative sign/condition predicates and ScanStringNumFor comparison with the native case-ignore module. Task AQF9AG ports ScanStartString source classification and early-return order over existing native owners. Task AQF9AG ports source ScanEndString trailing sign, decimal, percent, currency, date/time, AM/PM, weekday and compiled-literal control flow, retaining the disabled ISO timezone branch. Task AQF9AG ports ScanMidString source branch and state order with the pinned ISO timezone macro disabled. Task AQF9AG ports source IsNumberFormatMain dispatch, matching and type reconciliation; value conversion remains separate. Task AQF9AG ports TransformInput's non-ASCII digit gate and NATNUM0 forwarding through the native-number wrapper.
